_comment: The one canonical worked example cases 01, 03 and 04 all reference. Not read at render time by any case - each committed scene-spec.json carries its own exampleData copy so it stays independently reproducible with no other case having run. What ties them together is packages/web/src/shared-example-data.test.mjs, which asserts each case's exampleData.Q/K/V is byte-identical to this file. Change a number here, update the three cases to match, or the test names which case fell out of sync.
